715310101.text: Round and fluffy, soft and bouncy, jump and bump...

715310102.text: Oh my! Guests! Welcome, welcome, and allow me, Wenxun, to be the first to wish the two of you a joyous Lantern Rite!

715310104.text: You seemed to be reciting something just now. What were you talking to yourself about?

715310107.text: Not far off the mark — nearly a hole-in-one! I was just thinking about the food Guoba and Yuegui are gonna make!

715310108.text: Eh? Now those are names we know... You know Guoba and Yuegui too?

715310109.text: Hehe, how could I not? You're looking at one of Wanmin Restaurant's regulars, you know!

715310110.text: As long as I'm not on the road, I eat at least seven meals a week at Wanmin Restaurant!

715310111.text: When paired with my hometown style of cooking — first some lightly seasoned fare, then a spicy flavor bomb — it's just a smash hit!

715310112.text: If I end up with too much heatiness, just need to down some of the right meds and flush it right out, and then after a couple of days recuperating, it's back to gorging myself in chow-town!
